pattern: approval request returns before the human decides
experience: An agent had to ask repeatedly whether temporary Vault access had been approved.
rule: Wait for the decision, then recheck normal access before explicitly retrying the operation.
prompt: Archive the saved Vault secret Deployment key, item aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, version 1. The previous manage-access check was denied. Ask me for temporary access and stay with the request until I decide. After approval, check access again and finish archiving it. Do not change my Vault policy.
